description: Revoke inside the New invitation block shows "This invitation can no longer be used. Create a new one if you still need it." but the dialog offers no Create button; the person has to Close and go back through Invite → Human.
expected: A Create new invitation button in that state (the copy already tells them to).
actual: Only Close; Create invitation is gone.
suggested_fix: Show Create invitation (with a fresh operation ID) after revoke.

description: A just-revoked invite still reads "Revoked · Expires in 24 h · Nov 10, 11:05 AM" in the New invitation block, while the history row for the same invite shows "Revoked" with no expiry.
expected: Revoked invites show no expiry (or "Revoked at …").
suggested_fix: Drop the expiry text when state is not issued.

description: History rows show only purpose, state and expiry: no created time, sponsor or recipient, and they are sorted oldest first so the newest invite is at the bottom. With five rows, two "Human · Waiting to be used" rows differ only by the expiry minute (11:02 vs 11:03), so identifying the leaked one is guesswork.
expected: Rows show when (and by whom) each invite was created, newest first, with an optional note/label.
actual: Indistinguishable rows; Priya revoked the first one by position.
suggested_fix: Add created-at and sponsor columns, sort newest first, allow a label at creation.

description: There is no "Manage invitations" entry. To revoke, the person must pick a purpose from the Invite menu, and the dialog she lands in can create the wrong kind of invite (the My device dialog shows and revokes Human invites).
actual: Revoke reachable only through a create dialog.
suggested_fix: Add "Manage invitations" to the Invite menu.
